explanation.title: One batch. One receipt. A working planner.

paragraphs.text: Astra read the starter and proposed the implementation and regression tests together in one batch. After reviewing the rewrite, it sent a 92-character confirmation receipt. The factory applied the exact proposed files atomically, without making Astra generate them again.
Astra ran the test suite and delivered the planner in five actions. The unchanged program passed all five acceptance groups and all three additional graph and scale checks.

Native Astra inspected the starter, then wrote the implementation and regression tests and ran them in one shell call. Its final Git inspection found that the starter was not a Git checkout. It completed in 103.4 seconds.
The unchanged program passed all five acceptance groups and all three additional graph and scale checks. Open Files to inspect the implementation, or Tests for the exact results.
